newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores sales fall in February.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores sales fall in February.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Wednesday its total sales in the four weeks ended February 22 were $92.1 million, down from sales of $100.3 million for the four weeks ended February 27, 1996.
Sales for stores open more than one year fell 5.2 percent from February of 1996, the company said.
Venture said it plans to expand 14 additional departments this spring, including live plants, hardware, work clothes, golf and fishing.
Venture operates 113 stores in nine states.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Wednesday at 2-1/4.
